'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Graham Neal DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Graham Neal]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Notorious IG
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
